title: Core rules (shared)
description: Tool-agnostic accuracy and token rules in ~/.agents: CORE.md (always on via adapters), ROUTER.md and just-in-time instruction packs.
postInstall: Shared rules installed in ~/.agents (CORE.md, ROUTER.md, instructions/). Tool adapters inline CORE.md; edit the adapter blocks, not only CORE.md, if you change the always-on text.
